Had the end of the story been written by Robert Jordan it would have been 7 or 10 more books just to tie up all loose ends. Instead of the planned one book, it ended up in three and it was already shortened by Demandred's part in Shara and who knows what else was cut off.




I'm inconsolably sad of the loss of Robert Jordan. I finished the last 3 books in 3 days. Reading the Last Battle was a few hours of adrenalin rush as I would physically fight with them, and at the end (3 AM) I felt emptiness. My real catharsis was taken away from me. There was no fulfillment on Nicola's foretelling: "Three on the boat, and he who is dead yet lives. The great battle done, but the world not done with battle. The land divided by the return, and the guardians balance the servants."  and I guess it never be. :(
